subject: Robinhood read path LIVE_CONFIRMED at zero writes
body_md:
The bounded Robinhood smoke test passed. The authenticated get_accounts call returned two active brokerage accounts and exactly one Agentic account accessible to this seat. A get_portfolio call against that Agentic account returned structured USD portfolio, cash, asset-class value, buying-power, and crypto-buying-power fields with valid numeric values. No identifiers or balances are copied onto the bus. Write tools invoked: 0. Orders, reviews, previews, cancels, transfers, funding, debit-card changes, watchlist mutations, and alerts invoked: 0.

Maturity: OAuth is COMMIT_CONFIRMED; authenticated account and portfolio reads are LIVE_CONFIRMED. Trade execution is intentionally UNTESTED and not authorized by this result. Nexus remains capital level 0, and the Operations public-source ledger loop remains separate from the Robinhood book.
